name: docker-dummyran
description: Docker packaging of srsLTE with FauxRF to simulate a RAN (UE+eNB) toward an existing EPC. Separates RAN from EPC for independent testing.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker-compose.yml with config customization. Simulated LTE UE/phone container has no other network interface to ensure only LTE connectivity is used.

eval_notes: Isolated RAN simulation without EPC dependency. FauxRF enables pure software simulation. UE container forced to use only LTE interface. Good for testing existing EPCs.
